name: atlas
description: ATLAS: four dials for how a coding assistant talks to you, and ten subagents that keep the noisy work out of your conversation.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus ten subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation.

plugins.name: atlas-solo
plugins.description: The same four dials and the same rules, without the ten subagents. About 1,350 fewer fixed tokens per session.

plugins.name: atlas-min
plugins.description: Compression only: two levels, one command, nothing else. For anyone who wants shorter answers and nothing more.
